newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ share prices end steady on moderate volume.
newsitem.headline: NZ share prices end steady on moderate volume.

text.p: * New Zealand share prices end steady
* Most leaders soften, Lion Nathan gains
* Large line of Metropolitan Lifecare trades
Price movements at close
LAST CHG
313 -1 * NZSC cap index -1.34 at 4,951.33
345 +5 * Volume NZ$55 million. Futures untraded
654 -1 * Other movers - +12 -30
New Zealand share prices ended steady after a moderately active but directionless session.
The NZSE-40 Capital Index ended 1.53 points down at 2,252.01 on improved turnover worth NZ$55 million.
"The market does not have a lot of pattern to it, with the Dow jumping up and down all over the place. It just comes down to supply and demand," Paul Nicolson at SBC Warburg said.
"There is not too much driving this market," he said.
The Dow Jones Industrial Index had continued along its volatile path, finishing 92.71 points (1.41 percent) higher at 6,679.87.
In the leading issues, Lion was the only one to stand out, with a five-cent gain to NZ$3.45, after the completion of a recent big sell order.
The Warehouse, which gained 12 to NZ$3.70, attracted some large lines.
Among the minor issues, Metropolitan Lifecare gained three to NZ$1.30.
Sovereign Assurance later said it had sold its seven million Metropolitan Lifecare shares to other institutional investors at NZ$1.25 a share.
